Example 3 uses the distance formula to show equal distances to the center. The exercise uses the distance formula for collinearity.

Example 3 computes slopes, one from two points and one from tan 45°. It then uses equal slopes to show the lines are parallel.

The slope is read from the graph, and the blanks are unfilled. Then m is read as the coefficient of x. No use of the slope formula or tan E is shown.
